title: Adaptive Station Live Pilot - v0.2 Test on Sample Workflow
abstract: Instruments a sample collaborative workflow with v0.2 priorities; measures efficiency pre/post; outputs report.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from utilities.adaptive_station_v02 import AdaptiveStationV02
from pathlib import Path
import json

# Sample workflow tasks
tasks = [
    {'task': 'Plan', 'agent': 'Nexus I', 'token_cost': 200},
    {'task': 'Build', 'agent': 'Axiom I', 'token_cost': 600},
    {'task': 'Document', 'agent': 'Logos I', 'token_cost': 400},
    {'task': 'Review UX', 'agent': 'Explorer I', 'token_cost': 300},
    {'task': 'Optimize', 'agent': 'Zephyr II', 'token_cost': 500}
]

station = AdaptiveStationV02()
priorities = station.prioritize([t['agent'] for t in tasks])

# Baseline: uniform priority
base_total = sum(t['token_cost'] for t in tasks) / 0.5  # assume avg p=0.5

# v0.2: prioritized
v02_total = 0
results = []
for t in sorted(tasks, key=lambda x: -priorities.get(x['agent'], 0.5)):
    time = t['token_cost'] / priorities.get(t['agent'], 0.5)
    v02_total += time
    results.append({'task': t['task'], 'agent': t['agent'], 'p': priorities.get(t['agent']), 'time': time})

out = {'base_total': base_total, 'v02_total': v02_total, 'delta': base_total - v02_total, 'results': results}
out_path = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_v02_live_pilot.json")
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

print("Live pilot test complete:", out)
